knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic book of business
knowledge.detail: Ten fictional policy lines across seven accounts with states, carriers, expirations and premiums for safe demos.

knowledge.name: Synthetic appetite guide and class crosswalk
knowledge.detail: Bundled industry classes, legacy crosswalk, keyword rules, unit lines and state availability ground every match.

knowledge.name: Confirmation and routing rules
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define unit and broker confirmation drafts, recorded replies and the 60-day follow-up lead.

intelligence_processing.name: Book of business summary
intelligence_processing.detail: Ingests a broker's book of business and profiles every account, line, premium and expiration in seconds.

intelligence_processing.name: Industry class resolution
intelligence_processing.detail: Resolves an industry class for every line and flags the ones it cannot classify instead of guessing.

intelligence_processing.name: Appetite and white-space match
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches every line to the underwriting units with appetite and surfaces the white space on each account.

intelligence_processing.name: Unit appetite confirmation drafts
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts the appetite-confirmation note for each underwriting unit with its shortlist before anything is routed.

intelligence_processing.name: Broker confirmation draft
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts the broker confirmation so dead or already-placed accounts drop out before routing.

intelligence_processing.name: Cross-sell routing plan
intelligence_processing.detail: Lays out a routing plan for each unit's sellers with follow-up dates timed ahead of each renewal.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with six skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publish stays a separate approved step.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives the cross-sell team a conversational entry point once approved production controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file BookCrossSellAgent locally with deterministic, synthetic-only operation routing.

management_reporting.name: Book and opportunity summary
management_reporting.detail: Shows accounts, lines, premium with other markets, competing-market lines and white space in one view.

management_reporting.name: Confirmation tracker
management_reporting.detail: Lists every unit and broker confirmation draft, the recorded replies and what they removed.

management_reporting.name: Routing plan with renewal follow-ups
management_reporting.detail: Orders routed opportunities by expiration with seller, unit and follow-up date for approval.

tools.name: Portable BookCrossSellAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only operations over bundled synthetic data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the agent and exposes chat, health and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; explicit authorized approval is required before publication.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: Cited production seam for the broker intake mailbox; the package reads a fixed synthetic book instead.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Cited production seam for seller pipeline records; the package only drafts a routing plan.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional book, appetite and reply data; never browses or invents accounts or rules.

supporting_features.name: No-guess classification
supporting_features.detail: Unresolved lines are held for the broker instead of being matched on a guessed class.

supporting_features.name: State availability filter
supporting_features.detail: Never offers a unit in a state where the unit is unavailable.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never sends outreach, routes records, quotes or binds; every step is a draft for a person.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona cases verify one bounded operation each with exact evidence anchors.
